summary: Implemented Lemma 8 canonical modular addition and multiplication networks, achieving parsimonious encodings with O(d) edges and maximum degree bounded by 136(d+1)^{3/4}.
notes: Verified exhaustive parsimony for small moduli q in 2..7, witness acceptance and corrupted residue rejection for q in 3..13, and symbolic O(d^{3/4}) degree bounds up to q=257.
